title: Daemon handshake refuses clients when the workspace-root drive letter case differs (Windows)
outcome: On Windows, clients and daemon launched for the same physical worktree with differently spelled --workspace-root (c:/dev/monolith vs . resolving to C:\dev\monolith) agree on the endpoint (physical identity) but disagree on DatabaseKey, so default-path clients are refused with daemon_index_destination_mismatch. Fix: make the DatabaseKey derivation case-insensitive on Windows consistently with WorkspacePaths.FileSystemPathComparison, without breaking mixed-version daemon/client pairs whose launch strings already match.
acceptance: Daemon handshake refuses clients when the workspace-root drive letter case differs (Windows) is done

completion.summary: Delivered v0.12.85 canonical daemon destination identity across Windows drive-case, separator, dot/trailing, junction/symlink, and explicit database-path aliases, with bounded legacy handshake compatibility and decisive unit/live regressions.
